title: CI: a pull request that edits only the MCP server's SKILL.md renderer skips the Console test that pins its download mirror
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw7DekEe3wx5f3zphf

Filing gate: ① a named location. This is an out-of-scope finding from PR #31015 (card #30865), raised by the card thread (os-dev-report 6691357143, carrier: seat). ⛔ Not a claim. Triage sets the grade and the lane.
class: b · reach: every future edit to `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` that lands without the Console mirror; NOT MEASURED in CI (read from `.github/workflows/ci.yml` on the PR branch `828224c8`).

## Business reason

#30865 happened because the Console's "Download skill" SKILL.md drifted from the one the MCP server serves. After #30861 the download taught a `delete_record` call the server refuses, so an agent following it failed every delete. PR #31015 makes the mirror byte-identical and adds a drift pin: `ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/objectstack-skill.test.ts` compares the download with `renderSkillMarkdown` from `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts`. That pin only runs when Test UI runs. A pull request that edits only `skill-md.ts` matches neither the `ui` nor the `ui_consumers` filter, so Test UI skips. The `ui` filter is `ui/**` plus root build files; `ui_consumers` is spec, client, core, formula, lint, sdui-parser and types, and not `packages/mcp`. Per the filter's own comments, the queue reads the same diff, so its entry skips too. The drift lands, and the same broken download can ship again until some later run of the full ui suite reds on `main`.

## Where

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`, job `filter`: the `ui` / `ui_consumers` path lists, around lines 547–598 on `828224c8`.
- The pin: `ui/apps/console/src/pages/developer/objectstack-skill.test.ts` (`describe('renderObjectStackSkill mirrors renderSkillMarkdown')`). It lands with PR #31015.

## Wanted

A change to `packages/mcp/src/skill-md.ts` runs the Console test that pins its mirror, on the PR and in the queue. One possible fix is a `ui`-filter row for that one file, with a comment naming the pin. Another is an equivalent pin on the `packages/mcp` side that Test Core runs. Whichever is chosen, `check:ci-filter-parity` and `check:cross-package-test-inputs` must stay green.
